description: Send a message into a chat session via the gateway's chat layer. Wire format (verified live against gateway 2026.4.12+): requires `sessionKey` (composite, e.g. 'agent:main:main' from openclaw_sessions_list), `message`, and `idempotencyKey` (auto-generated UUID if omitted). The pre-0.5.x `agentId`/`sessionId`/`text` shape is rejected by the gateway. Destructive — triggers an agent turn.

idempotencyKey.description: Unique key to dedupe retries. Auto-generated UUID if omitted.

instance.description: Optional OpenClaw instance to route this call to (e.g. 'default', 'work'). Falls back to the active default instance, or the OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_URL/TOKEN env vars when set. List configured instances with openclaw_setup_list.

name: openclaw_chat_send
